summary: 3D animation project with dynamic, calming rotating background

existing_features.title: Replace the current animated gradient background with a Three.js 3D scene that continuously rotates and changes camera angles to create a calming, unique visual effect
Implement the 3D scene using React Three Fiber with an abstract geometric shape that serves as the focal point for the rotating camera
Configure camera animation to rotate continuously with varying speeds and angles to create a unique, mesmerizing effect that never repeats exactly
Ensure the 3D background maintains visual harmony with the existing OKLCH color system and adapts to light/dark theme changes

new_feature_requests.summary: Add 3D rotating background image with continuously changing angles for calming, unique effect
